newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Dairygold says will await result of Waterford offer.
newsitem.headline: Dairygold says will await result of Waterford offer.

text.p: Dairygold Co-Operative Society said on Tuesday that while it had a keen interest in the outcome of Avonmore Foods Plc's recent approach to Waterford Foods Plc it would not interfere while Waterford considered the offer.
Ireland's food producer Avonmore formalised an offer for rival Waterford Foods on Monday last offering one Avonmore share for every two Waterford shares in a merger proposal.

Dairygold chief executive Denis Lucey said in a statement that Dairygold maintained "an excellent and harmonious" relationship with Waterford Foods and it had a very keen interest in the outcome of Avonmore's offer for Waterford.
Lucey said, however, that while Waterford was considering the offer Dairygold would do nothing to distract it in that process.

If Avonmore succeeds in its proposed merger the new group will generate a combined turnover of 2.5 billion Irish pounds and 71.5 million pre-tax profits and will catapult the food company onto the world stage with interests on both sides of the Atlantic.
To succeed the merger must be ratified by 75 percent of Waterford Co-op, which owns 68 percent of the Plc shares, and Waterford Foods Plc members.
